summary: toUpperCase returns a new string using Unicode uppercase mappings.
documentation: toUpperCase returns a new string using Unicode uppercase mappings. It does not change the original string, trim spaces or validate the resulting text. Some mappings change the string’s length.
caution: Case conversion is not a universal identity comparison. Locale-sensitive rules can differ, and output length may increase.
scenarios: Prepare uppercase headings in a local export.
Normalize case for a documented ASCII-only internal code.
title: Display an uppercase label
problem: Input is a string. Return its uppercase form without removing spaces or punctuation. Use JavaScript’s normal Unicode mapping, so straße becomes STRASSE.
goal: Use String.toUpperCase() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Call toUpperCase on the input string.
